title: Failure probability for partial-sum checks
statement: Let $m$ be a natural number, let $w$ be a Boolean string of length $m+2$, and let $p$ be a Boolean string of length $m+1$. Consider the $m+2$ checks consisting of the initial check that $p_0=w_0+w_1$ modulo $2$, the final check that $p_m=1$, and, for each $k	ext{ with }0\le k<m$, the transition check that $p_{k+1}=p_k+w_{k+2}$ modulo $2$. If a specified check in this collection fails, then a uniformly chosen check from the collection fails with probability at least $1/(m+2)$.
hypotheses_covered: A specified check from the collection fails
